name: Speedy Chicken Noodle Soup with Egg
method: Lower the eggs into boiling water and simmer for 6 to 7 minutes, then cool in cold water, peel and halve.
Dissolve the stock cube in 700ml boiling water in a pan, add the noodles and simmer for 4 minutes.
Stir the spinach into the broth for 1 minute until wilted, then add the soy sauce.
Ladle the noodles and broth into two bowls and top with the sliced chicken, the egg halves, coriander and a pinch of chilli flakes.
